judged_text: The recurring-cancellation branch was moved inside the per-reference loop but ignores the loop's reference: for every calendar reference it re-runs `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...endsWith('_calendar'))` and deletes all updated bookings' events across all credentials. A booking with N calendar references now issues N × (all user calendar credentials) × updatedBookings deleteEvent calls for one logical cancel — duplicate deletions (extra external API calls, spurious 404/log errors) and N-fold fan-out on the reference-x-credential pattern.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, `bookingCalendarReference` was changed from `find(...)` to `filter(...)` and wrapped in `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference) { ... }`. Inside the `credentialId` branch, the recurring/allRemainingBookings path still builds `promises` from **all** `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter((credential) => credential.type.endsWith('_calendar'))` and iterates **all** `updatedBookings` to delete their calendar refs. Because this whole recurring-deletion block is now inside the per-reference loop and does not use the loop’s `reference`, a booking with N calendar references will re-run the full (all calendar credentials × updatedBookings) deletion work N times, causing duplicated external deletes and potential extra 404/log noise.
